channel.description: Recent content on Drum Machine Funk

item.title: Cornerman
item.description:
Cornerman is a companion app for the Teenage Engineering KO II sampler composer.
The app uses a USB-C connection to save and restore backups from the KO II.

item.title: SL950
item.description: SL950 is an iPad and iPhone application that connects to your AKAI S950 sampler over a MIDI connection and let’s you edit all parameters of the programs and samples. Speed up your workflow by creating and generating keygroups and chopping up samples!

item.title: SPL-12
item.description: The SPL-12 Sampling Percussion Librarian is a companion app for the E-mu SP-12 Sampling Percussion drum machine.The application makes no sound on it’s own. It’s purpuse is to provide a convenient way to save and load sequencer and sound memory data via a MIDI connection.We hope enthusiasts will find this utility useful and keep the spirit of 12-bit sampling alive for many years to come. Enjoy!

item.title: iDP/4
item.description: iDP/4 is an iPad application that connects to your Ensoniq DP/4 over a MIDI connection and let’s you edit all parameters of the 4 effect blocks as well as the routing between them.

item.title: Tilos Radio
item.description: Tilos Radio is a unique and independent radio station based in Budapest, Hungary, known for its progressive voice and community-oriented approach. Since its inception in the early 1990s, Tilos has championed freedom of speech, diversity of opinion, and artistic experimentation, making it a prominent alternative to mainstream media in the region. Originally broadcasting illegally as a pirate station, Tilos—meaning “forbidden” in Hungarian—has since evolved into a legal and widely respected platform for underground music, social commentary, and grassroots activism.

item.title: Lahmacun Radio
item.description:
Lahmacun Radio is a Budapest-based online community radio station founded in 2018, showcasing the city’s various subcultures and musical scenes. The station’s studio is located in Kazán Community House, situated in District VIII, on the grounds of a former factory that now hosts numerous cultural and social projects.

Lahmacun Radio works not only with local but also international hosts, including contributors from Brussels, Edinburgh, Berlin, San Francisco, and Belgrade. Additionally, it collaborates with other online radio stations such as Radio Kapital from Poland, Cashmere Radio from Germany, and IDA Radio from Estonia.

item.title: Pixel Works
item.description:
Pixel Works is a graphics application to design small pixel graphics, animations and fonts for monochrome displays. Design small animations and pixel fonts for embedded projects and OLED screens.

The application supports export to animated GIF and GFXFont.

item.title: Vinyl Discovery
item.description:
Vinyl Discovery is a record-digging app built on the Discogs catalog. Pick a genre, a style, a year or a country, and the app turns the results into a playlist that plays each release’s videos from YouTube, one record after another.

Start with a curated pocket, such as 1984 Japanese city pop or 1992 Detroit techno, or build your own search and let it play. When something catches your ear, save it to a YouTube playlist or open the release on Discogs to add it to your wantlist.

item.title: Dil Maddy - The Archives
item.description:
Hungary’s renown beatmaker, Dil Maddy presents “The Archives” - a collection of carefully crafted beats from the heart of Budapest. It’s the first time these songs are presented in their full instrumental glory venturing into heavy hitting boom bap bangers, melancholic breakbeat soundscapes and soulful sample puzzles. The tracks include beats from previous collaborations, remixes and one-offs spanning almost a decade in the making.

All tracks have been produced & mixed by Dil Maddy on the MPC2000XL, MPC60, S1000 and S3000 using vinyl samples between 2010 and 2017 in Budapest, Hungary.

item.title: About
item.description:
We are Drum Machine Funk, a creative digital workshop and record label based in Budapest, Hungary.

We love to design and implement creative, unconventional digital solutions informed by our love for creative arts, music, playfulness and inclusivity. We love music and everything that is connected to it: vinyl records, electronic and acoustic instruments, drum machines and synthesizers.

If you have a project in mind that you would like to talk to us about feel free to get in touch by contacting us at hello@drummachinefunk.com.

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.description: We take your privacy seriously. This app does not collect any personal data or information from its users. We do not track your usage, access your contacts, or gather any other data from your device. Your privacy is important to us, and we are committed to ensuring that your information remains secure and confidential. This app may utilize certain features provided by the iOS platform, such as access to the camera or microphone, but these features are only used to provide functionality within the app itself and are not used to collect or transmit any personal data. By using this app, you agree to this privacy policy. If you have any questions or concerns about our privacy practices, please contact us at hello@drummachinefunk.com.

item.title: Vinyl Discovery Privacy Policy
item.description:
Last updated: November 17, 2026

Vinyl Discovery is made by Drum Machine Funk. We don’t run our own servers for the app, and we don’t collect analytics or show ads. This policy explains what the app stores and which third-party services it uses.

Data stored on your device

  • Sign-in tokens. When you sign in with Discogs or Google, the app stores the access tokens in the iOS Keychain on your device. They are used only to talk to those services on your behalf.
  • Your Discogs username and basic session details, used to show your account in Settings.
  • Recent searches and the number of releases you played today, used for search suggestions and the free daily limit.

Signing out in Settings removes the stored tokens. Deleting the app removes all of this data from your device.

item.title: Vinyl Discovery Terms of Use
item.description:
Last updated: November 17, 2026

By using Vinyl Discovery you agree to these terms and to Apple’s Standard End User License Agreement.

Free use and subscriptions

Vinyl Discovery is free to use with a daily limit of 10 releases. A paid plan removes the limit:

  • Monthly and yearly subscriptions are charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase. They renew automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.
  • Lifetime is a one-time purchase with no renewal.

Prices are shown in the app before you buy. Refunds are handled by Apple under its own policies. You can restore earlier purchases from Settings.
